titre: ‘See y’all in Leonida’: Jason’s actor finally confirms he’s in GTA 6
chapo: Jason and Lucia's actors finally confirm they are in GTA 6
extrait: It has finally been confirmed that Dylan Rourke plays Jason Duval in Grand Theft Auto 6. This comes after years of speculation, with many fans correctly guessing that he was playing Jason based on his appearance and voice matching what we had seen of the character in trailers. It also comes after Manni L. Perez was confirmed to be playing Lucina Caminos before GTA 6’s launch, as she was nominated for Best Performance at The Game Awards. Perez and Rourke have now issued a joint statement on their involvement in GTA 6. This is the first time either actor has commented on their role in the game. “Years witnessing the hardest-working and most skilled artisans game-making has to offer,” the joint post reads. “We are truly honored to collaborate on this worldwide testament to human creativity, ingenuity, and sheer willpower. So much learned and so much to learn, keep fighting for what you love, stay humble. See yâall in Leonida.” Rockstar had kept the identities of Jason and Lucina’s actors under wraps, even after fans had long guessed who would be playing them. They’ve only both been confirmed now that GTA 6 is out in all regions, despite many fans playing it yesterday. Like Perez, Rourke is a lesser-known actor with a few television credits to his name prior to GTA 6. Unlike Perez, it appears that GTA 6 is his first role in a video game. All eyes will be on them now, as this breakout role for the pair is now the best-selling and best-reviewed game of all time, as per Metacritic. Now that the game is in our hands and NDA’s are expiring, it’s clear that Rockstar packed a lot of stars into GTA 6. In particular, there are some familiar voices on the radio, with shows hosted by fictional characters played by the likes of Weird Al” Yankovic and comedian Stavros Halkias.

titre: GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Actors Spotted Together in First Photo
chapo: The actors behind GTA 6 protagonists Jason and Lucia have finally been pictured together, after years of speculation regarding their identities.
extrait: The actors behind GTA 6 protagonists Jason and Lucia have finally been pictured together, after years of speculation regarding their identities. As we learned earlier this week, Lucia is played by Manni L. Perez — though this casting was only confirmed as the actress received a Game Awards nomination for her work. Now, we can see Jason actor Dylan Rourke revealed and in the flesh too, sharing a hug with Perez and her stunt double Victoria Lee, while standing in front of a giant Grand Theft Auto 6 billboard. "Well... the secret's finally out!" Lee posted on Instagram today. "After keeping my mouth shut for YEEAARRSSS (and what feels like FOREVER!!! 😂), I can finally share that I've been lucky enough to help bring LUCIA to life as her MAIN STUNT DOUBLE in GRAND THEFT AUTO 6, along with a whole bunch of other characters stunts along the way!" Lee's photo is the first time we've seen Rourke publicly confirmed to be playing Jason, although his name has been circulating online over the past 24 hours from some who had received early copies of the game. Regardless, this is our first chance to see the real-life Jason and Lucia together, after years and years of Rockstar secrecy keeping their identities under wraps. "Thousands of hours, countless memories, and one HELL of a ride!" Lee continued. "The amount of blood, sweat, tears, and IMPACT that went into bringing this world to life is unreal! Oh, and did I mention the impact?!... Yeah, that s***'s REAL!!! 😂💥😵‍💫 "So many incredibly talented people poured their hearts and souls into this game, and I'm beyond grateful to have been part of something so massive! A special shoutout to Manni and Dylan! ❤️ You two are truly amazing humans, inside and out! So much talent, heart, and genuine goodness. I'm forever grateful to have shared this wild ride with you both! Thank you for being so freaking awesome! ❤️❤️❤️ "To everyone who helped make this game possible, thank you for an unforgettable experience! ❤️ And to everyone about to experience Vice City… **BUCKLE UP, BITCHESSSSS!!!!!!!** 😈🔥 **WELCOME TO VICE CITY!!!**" Like Perez, Rourke is an actor with a history of TV guest roles in series you'll have heard of, including Modern Family and Grey's Anatomy — though no real breakout appearances to date. Of course, all of that has now changed with the actor fronting one of the biggest entertainment releases of all time. Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next?
